text:
alex: heads up — saw weird split skew on the rollout for model v2. console shows ~98% of traffic going to the canary for a subset of clients (not global). wondering if client_id prefix rules are matching too broadly.
jamie: can you paste the route config? is this header-based or prefix-based? :thinking_face:
alex: its a client_id prefix rule we added yesterday to route enterprise keys starting with 'ent-vo2'. config snippet from console:
alex: ```
- match: prefix(client_id, 'ent-vo')
  weight: 50
- match: prefix(client_id, 'ent-vo2')
  weight: 50
``` 
alex: the weird part is traffic distribution in EU region — almost everyone with keys starting 'ent-vo' ended up routed to the newer canary even when the console weight was 50/50.
sara: my guess: the prefix predicate is implemented as substring rather than anchored prefix in the runtime, so 'ent-vo2' may be matching 'ent-vo' group or vice versa. also could be collision with the fallback guard that biases to lower-latency pool.
matt: infra-bot logs show a fallback loop: when capacity low, guard policy favors model_variant "v2-canary" in eu-west. then sticky session persists the variant on subsequent requests. combined with the broad prefix, that amplifies the canary. see alert: {{alert_id: 9876}} from 1779013000.
infra-bot: alert fired: rollout-imbalance (id=9876) — P90 routing skew > 75% for group prefix ent-vo in eu-west. links: https://console/redwood/rollouts/9876
jamie: can you grep the runtime matcher? maybe match order is nondeterministic. if both predicates evaluate true, we pick first in map which changed after last deploy.
viola: quick repro: client_id=ent-vo23 should match ent-vo not ent-vo2. but with current substring matcher it matches both and the map insertion order put ent-vo2 first. that explains the 98%.
sara: proposed fixes:
- make prefix matching anchored (startsWith) at runtime
- add explicit tie-breaker that uses stable hash(client_id) when multiple rules match
- ensure guard fallback doesn't permanently sticky across route changes
matt: agree. short-term mitigation: pin the canary pool to not accept sticky cookies for those enterprise keys (disable session affinity for the route), and redeploy matcher patch.
alex: patch to make startsWith submitted in PR #4123. snippet:
alex: ```js
// matcher change
if (clientId.rstartsWith(prefix)) {
  // old behavior
}
// -> fix to use startsWith
if (clientId.startsWith(prefix)) {
  // correct
}
```
jamie: also add unit tests for overlapping prefixes and add an e2e rollout test that simulates fallback pressure.
viola: i've kicked a canary rollback for eu-west, rolling back affinity flags now. monitoring the alert.
infra-bot: action: rollback initiated by viola at 1779013900. status: in-progress.
alex: thanks all — once PR lands, let's run the synthetic with 10k synthetic client_ids and confirm split stabilizes.
jamie: noted. i'll add a dashboard panel for prefix-match collisions + sticky-session counts.
sara: follow-up owner: jamie (matcher tests), matt (guard/fallback change), alex (matcher PR). target: patch and deploy tomorrow UTC.
viola: ok, will watch the infra alerts and escalate if skew persists. :thumbsup:
